subject: ACME MAP: Integration build plan - owners & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME MAP: Integration build plan - owners & next steps

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the MAP milestone around the integration build plan (SDK integration, streaming/tool-calling, structured outputs).

Recap (call highlights):
- Primary integration path: SDK-based integration with optional server-side streaming (SSE/WebSocket) for live updates.
- Tool calling: ACME will expose a small set of internal tools (inventory lookup, shipment-status) that Redwood will call via secure webhook.
- Structured outputs: Expected JSON schema for shipment summaries and exceptions; ACME will provide example payloads.

Proposed immediate next steps (we'll draft MAP with milestones and owners):
1) Redwood to share MAP draft and integration build plan (owners + milestones) -- Ben/Marissa -- by EOD Monday.
2) ACME to confirm internal owners and any compliance/security gating items -- Rebecca -- by Wed.
3) Align on target close date and dependencies (SOC2 evidence, network access) -- joint.

Can you confirm those owners and whether June 30 works as a target close date for your team? If not, suggest an alternate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.inference>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME MAP: Integration build plan - owners & next steps

Rebecca / team —

Thanks for the quick call yesterday. Per Ben's note, I've attached a draft MAP focused on the Integration Build milestone and a complementary integration-build-plan spreadsheet that breaks down milestones, owners, target dates, and dependencies. High level owners assigned below -- please review and confirm.

Milestones & owners (draft):
- SDK integration (client libs, auth flows, examples) -- Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Streaming endpoints (SSE/WebSocket; client examples + server infra) -- Owner: Ethan Park (Redwood)
- Tool calling integration (webhook auth, retry semantics, schema) -- Owner: Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood)
- Structured output schema & validation (JSON schema, sample outputs, QA) -- Owner: Lukas Meyer (Redwood)
- Customer-specific mapping & test harness (sample data + QA runs) -- Owner: Rebecca Liu (ACME)
- Security/compliance checkpoint (network access, encryption, SOC2 evidence) -- Owner: ACME Security Team (TBD)

Target close date (proposed): 2027-06-30
Key dependencies:
- SOC2 evidence & network ingress rule approvals (ACME security)
- API key distribution and secrets handling (ACME infra)
- Tool endpoint contract and example payloads (ACME integration team)

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (MAP draft), integration-build-plan.xlsx (milestone spreadsheet)

Related links: MAP draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cACME-MAP-DRAFT
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-12345

Rebecca -- can you confirm the ACME owners for the two ACME-side items and confirm whether the proposed target close date works? I can update the MAP and re-share for signature after we get those confirmations.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: ACME_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (pdf, 320KB), integration-build-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: ACME Integration Team <integration@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME MAP: Integration build plan - owners & next steps

Thanks Marissa -- this looks great and very helpful. Quick replies/requests from ACME: 

1) Confirmed ACME owners:
   - Customer-specific mapping & test harness -- Rebecca Liu (ACME Integration Lead)
   - Security/compliance checkpoint -- I will loop in James Park (ACME SecOps) to confirm timeline; tentative owner set to James.Park@acme.com.

2) Timeline: June 30 is aggressive but possible if we get SOC2 evidence and network access by May 10. Can Redwood help prioritize the SOC2 artifacts?

3) Integration questions:
   - For streaming, do you provide a retry/backpressure pattern in the SDK or should we expect to implement on our side?
   - For tool-calling, we need a short SLA on webhook retries and guidance on idempotency.

Next steps: I'll confirm James and ACME infra owners by Wednesday and share sample payloads for structured outputs by end of week.

Thanks -- Rebecca
Rebecca Liu
Integration Lead, ACME Logistics
rebecca.liu@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.inference>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME MAP: Integration build plan - owners & next steps

Rebecca -- great, thanks for the quick confirmation and the dependencies note. A few short answers and proposed follow-ups: 

Answers:
- Streaming retries/backpressure: Redwood's SDK includes a recommended client-side backpressure pattern and automatic reconnect logic; we'll include example code in the SDK samples. For server-side backpressure we'll provide guidance and a reference implementation (Ethan will own).
- Tool-calling SLA & idempotency: We recommend webhook retry with exponential backoff + idempotency keys; Redwood will include recommended webhook semantics and a sample middleware. Stephanie will draft the SLA language for MAP.

Proposed changes to MAP & next steps: 
1) Marissa to update MAP with confirmed ACME owners and add James Park as SecOps owner (expected Wed).
2) Redwood (Ethan) to prioritize streaming reference and sample code; aim to deliver by 2027-05-07.
3) Stephanie to draft webhook retry/idempotency guidance and SLA language; deliver by 2027-05-03.
4) ACME to share SOC2 evidence & network rules by 2027-05-10 (dependency gate).
5) Joint validation run (test harness + sample data) planned for week of 2027-06-07.

Target close date remains 2027-06-30 assuming dependencies are met. I'll update the HubSpot deal with the MAP and milestone dates after Marissa's MAP update.

Links: MAP draft (Drive) and HubSpot deal above.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
